title: Market Structure & Order Flow
subtitle: The order book, the auctions, Reg NMS, wholesalers and dark pools, market makers, the tape and what order flow can and cannot tell you, measured on real data.
what_you_learn: Walk a market order through a limit order book, compute its average fill and effective spread, and see why displayed depth is not a commitment
Read the opening and closing auction feeds, find a clearing price from an imbalance, and measure on 60 sessions of SPY bars why the close is the day's biggest print
Explain Reg NMS, the NBBO and order protection, maker-taker fees from Nasdaq's schedule, and the 2024 and 2026 rule changes that alter them
Quantify off-exchange trading from FINRA and Cboe data (50.6% of 2025 volume), read a Rule 606 report, and convert payment for order flow into basis points
Derive a dealer's spread from Glosten-Milgrom, classify prints by aggressor with Lee-Ready, compute delta and cumulative delta, and cite the evidence for and against them
Estimate dealer gamma hedging, market impact by the square-root law and implementation shortfall; recognise spoofing from the prosecuted cases; and build a nine-rule set from the evidence
